function.name: debugstr_format
function.description: This function formats the debug string based on the given UINT id. It first gets the last Win32 error and stores it. Then it tries to get the clipboard format name for the given id. If successful, it formats the debug string with the id and the obtained name. If not, it checks if the id matches any of the built-in ids and returns the corresponding string. If the id doesn't match any built-in id, it simply formats the debug string with the id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id for which the debug string is to be formatted.

function.return_type: char: Returns a formatted debug string.

function.name: get_cached_format
function.description: This function searches for a cached format in a list of cached formats and returns it if found. If not found, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: This parameter represents the format to be searched in the cached formats.

function.return_type: struct cached_format* - A pointer to the cached format if found, otherwise NULL.

function.name: free_cached_data
function.description: This function frees up the memory allocated to the cached data. It also performs different actions based on the format of the cached data.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the cached data structure that needs to be freed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: free_cached_formats
function.description: This function iterates over a list, removes each element and frees the cached data associated with it.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: A pointer to the list whose elements are to be removed and their associated cached data freed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: invalidate_memory_formats
function.description: This function iterates over a list of cached formats and removes any format that is not a bitmap, dspbitmap, palette, enhmetafile, dspenhmetafile, metafilepict, or dspmetafilepict. The removed formats are then added to a free list.

parameters.name: free_list
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a list where the removed formats will be added.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: NtUserOpenClipboard
function.description: This function opens the clipboard for the current task and empties it.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window to be associated with the open clipboard.

parameters.name: unk
parameters.description: An unknown parameter, its purpose is not clear from the function definition.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns a boolean value indicating the success or failure of the operation.

function.name: NtUserCloseClipboard
function.description: This function closes the clipboard and notifies the clipboard viewer window.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the clipboard was successfully closed or not.

function.name: NtUserEmptyClipboard
function.description: This function empties the clipboard and frees the memory associated with data stored in the clipboard. It also sends a message to the clipboard owner if it exists.
function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the clipboard was successfully emptied, otherwise FALSE

function.name: NtUserCountClipboardFormats
function.description: This function counts the number of formats currently available on the clipboard.
function.return_type: INT, represents the number of formats available on the clipboard

function.name: NtUserIsClipboardFormatAvailable
function.description: This function checks if a specific clipboard format is available.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: This parameter represents the format to check for availability in the clipboard.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the specified format is available in the clipboard, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: NtUserGetUpdatedClipboardFormats
function.description: This function retrieves the updated clipboard formats.

parameters.name: formats
parameters.description: Pointer to the array that receives the clipboard formats.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Specifies the size of the array pointed to by the formats parameter.

parameters.name: out_size
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the number of clipboard formats copied to the array.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds; otherwise, it returns FALSE.

function.name: NtUserGetPriorityClipboardFormat
function.description: This function checks the availability of clipboard formats in the given list and returns the first available format. If no format is available, it returns -1. If the clipboard is empty, it returns 0.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an array of clipboard formats to check for availability.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: This is the number of clipboard formats in the list.

function.return_type: INT. It represents the first available clipboard format in the list. If no format is available, it returns -1. If the clipboard is empty, it returns 0.

function.name: NtUserGetClipboardFormatName
function.description: This function retrieves the name of the clipboard format for the given format identifier.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The format identifier for the clipboard format.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: A pointer to the buffer that receives the clipboard format name.

parameters.name: maxlen
parameters.description: The maximum length, in characters, of the clipboard format name.

function.return_type: INT, represents the length of the string copied to the buffer. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: NtUserGetClipboardOwner
function.description: This function is used to get the owner of the clipboard.
function.return_type: HWND, which represents a handle to the window that owns the clipboard

function.name: NtUserSetClipboardViewer
function.description: This function sets the specified window as the clipboard viewer and sends a WM_DRAWCLIPBOARD message to the window. If the function is successful, the return value is the handle to the previous clipboard viewer.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window to be set as the new clipboard viewer.

function.return_type: HWND, represents the handle to the previous clipboard viewer.

function.name: NtUserGetClipboardViewer
function.description: This function retrieves the window handle of the current clipboard viewer.
function.return_type: HWND, represents the handle to the window that is currently viewing the clipboard.

function.name: NtUserChangeClipboardChain
function.description: This function changes the clipboard chain by setting a new clipboard viewer and removing the old one. It also handles the case where the request is still pending or if an error occurs.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window to be removed from the clipboard viewer chain

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Handle to the window to be added to the clipboard viewer chain

function.return_type: BOOL, where TRUE indicates that the function succeeded and FALSE indicates that the function failed or the request is still pending

function.name: NtUserGetOpenClipboardWindow
function.description: This function is used to get the window handle of the open clipboard window.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: HWND, which represents the handle to the open clipboard window.

function.name: NtUserGetClipboardSequenceNumber
function.description: This function retrieves the clipboard sequence number.
function.return_type: DWORD, represents the clipboard sequence number

function.name: NtUserEnumClipboardFormats
function.description: This function is used to enumerate the clipboard formats.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: This parameter represents the format to be enumerated.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the enumerated format.

function.name: NtUserAddClipboardFormatListener
function.description: This function adds a window to the clipboard format listener list.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window to be added to the clipboard format listener list.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds; otherwise FALSE.

function.name: NtUserRemoveClipboardFormatListener
function.description: This function removes a window from the clipboard format listener list.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window to be removed from the clipboard format listener list.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the operation was successful or not.

function.name: release_clipboard_owner
function.description: This function releases the clipboard owner by sending a message to render all formats, then it starts a server request to release the clipboard. If the server call is successful, it retrieves the viewer and owner from the server reply. If a viewer is present, it sends a message to draw the clipboard.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window that owns the clipboard

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: NtUserSetClipboardData
function.description: This function sets the clipboard data in a specific format. It also handles caching of the clipboard data and synchronization using a mutex.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The format in which the clipboard data is to be set.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Handle to the data to be set on the clipboard.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure containing additional parameters for setting the clipboard data, including whether to cache only, the data to be set, and its size.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful, otherwise returns an error status.

function.name: NtUserGetClipboardData
function.description: This function retrieves data from the clipboard in a specified format. It also handles caching and rendering of the data.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The format of the clipboard data to retrieve.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A pointer to a structure that contains parameters for retrieving the clipboard data.

function.return_type: HANDLE. It represents a handle to the clipboard data in the specified format. If the function fails, it returns NULL.

function.name: drag_drop_call
function.description: This function handles different drag and drop events and calls the appropriate user mode callback based on the event type.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window that receives the message.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The message to be processed.

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: A pointer to additional data.

function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the result of the message processing and depends on the message sent.
